findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: There are Parmesan cheese shakers observed to be stored on tables for consumer use. According to the PIC in the kitchen, these shakers are put in the cooler every night and then placed on the tables every day for consumer use. The cheese is imported grated pecorino Romano cheese from Casale and the box is stored in the walk-in cooler and states to “KEEP REFRIGERATED”. The facility can either cease this practice and store the Parmesan cheese shakers in a cooler and remove them only when a consumer wants to use them OR can reach out to the manufacturer to determine if the Parmesan cheese only needs to be refrigerated for QUALITY and not SAFETY. A follow up is scheduled for 8/5/2026 to allow time for the facility to decide and to reach out to the manufacturer. Ensure that proof is provided if reaching out to the manufacturer. If there are any questions, please reach out to the inspector.

2-301.12: Observed an employee wash his hands for only a few seconds and did not use a barrier when Turning off the faucet after washing his hands. Ensure employees properly wash their hands. Also, employees were observed cleaning and then went to prep food without washing their hands. Ensure employees wash their hands when changing tasks and before food prep. Proper hand washing education was provided.  

(A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.comment:

(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: Observed wet wiping cloths to not be stored inside sanitizer between uses. Wiping cloths were observed on counters, inside a hand sink, and on prep tables. Ensure wiping cloths are properly stored inside sanitizer. 
(A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.comment:

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed a cut tomato dish in the prep cooler with a date of 8/9 and sliced roast beef in the walk in cooler with a date mark of 8/8. All ready to eat, potentially hazardous products that require time and temperature control for safety must be date marked with the date of opening or preparation and held no longer than 7 days maximum. The day opened or prepared counts as Day 1. These items were discarded during the inspection. Observed three open gallons of milk in coolers that were not date marked with the date of opening. findings.title: Foods properly cooked and/or reheated

750-210  Potentially hazardous foods shall be reheated rapidly to 165°F or higher through out the product. Properly reheat food to 165°F or above.

Make sure to record the time the cooling process begins to ensure that foods are reaching 70F within 2 hours and 41F or below within an additional 4 hours.
750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F.
